results.name: Lord of the Dance
instructions: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot or ankle behind you.
Reach your free arm forward.
Kick your foot back into your hand as you tilt your torso forward.
Hold the balance, then switch sides.
tips: Focus your eyes on one point for balance.
Keep the standing knee soft.
results.description: Lord of the Dance is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Monkey Pose
instructions: From a low lunge, slowly slide your front heel forward and your back knee back.
Support yourself with your hands on the floor or on blocks.
Lower your hips toward the floor in a split, as far as is comfortable.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
tips: Use blocks under your hands and hips.
Never force the split.
results.description: Monkey Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Glutes.

results.name: One Arm Cow Face Pose - Easy
instructions: Sit or stand tall.
Reach one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your back.
With your other hand, gently press the bent elbow back.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your head upright.
Use a strap if needed.
results.description: One Arm Cow Face Pose - Easy is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lats.

results.name: Pigeon Glutes Stretch
instructions: From a plank or all fours, bring one knee forward behind your wrist with the shin angled across.
Extend the other leg straight back.
Lower your hips toward the floor and fold forward over your front leg.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
tips: Put a cushion under your hip if it doesn't reach the floor.
Keep your hips level.
results.description: Pigeon Glutes Stretch is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Pigeon Pose
instructions: From all fours, bring one knee forward toward your wrist with the shin angled across your body.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Lower your hips and keep your chest lifted.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
tips: Square your hips toward the front.
Use a block under your hip if needed.
results.description: Pigeon Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Puppy Pose
instructions: Start on all fours.
Walk your hands forward, keeping your hips over your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Rest your forehead down and hold, breathing slowly.
tips: Keep your arms active.
Let your chest melt toward the floor.
results.description: Puppy Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Chest.

results.name: Pyramid Pose - Parsvottanasana
instructions: Stand with one foot forward and the other back, feet about 3 feet apart and the back foot turned out slightly.
Square your hips toward the front.
Hinge forward over your front leg with a long spine.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Bend your front knee slightly if needed.
Lead with your chest.
results.description: Pyramid Pose - Parsvottanasana is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Lower Back.

results.name: Pyramid Pose Blocks
instructions: Stand in a split stance with yoga blocks on either side of your front foot.
Square your hips forward.
Hinge forward and place your hands on the blocks.
Hold with a long spine, then switch sides.
tips: Raise the blocks if your back rounds.
Keep both legs active.
results.description: Pyramid Pose Blocks is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Lower Back.

results.name: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the ball of your front foot raised on a block.
Square your hips forward.
Hinge forward over the front leg.
Hold, feeling the stretch in your calf and hamstring, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your heel down on the floor.
Go only as far as is comfortable.
results.description: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Pyramid Prayer
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the back foot turned out slightly.
Join your palms behind your back in a reverse prayer, or hold your elbows.
Hinge forward over the front leg with a long spine.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Hold your elbows if reverse prayer is too intense.
Keep your chest open.
results.description: Pyramid Prayer is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.
